title: Card Fan
description: A daily card draw: a hand of playing cards fanned around a pivot far below the table.
steps: `itemSize` 44 gives each card a thin slice of the drag, and `autoplay` deals the next one every 1.6 s.
`itemAnimation` turns each card by `value × 8°` around a `transformOrigin` 360 pt below its centre and lifts the current one 30 pt.
`progress` lights up the rank strip; tapping a rank or Shuffle calls `scrollTo({ index })`.
